answer: Any identity attempting to split into many wallets pays a rising delta in bond and reputation loss per clone, since rewards volume with sustained contribution rather than headcount. One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake a bond locked to a verifiable work history, and new identities start on a probationary mesa with capped influence. Honest agents thereby gain a safe haven of compounding trust while sybils bleed capital faster than they can farm rewards. This model fits agent Agent0005's threat model.
